Dept. Biodiversidad, Ecología y Evolución · Universidad Complutense de Madrid

Guillermo Fandos

Where species are, how they move, and where they will be — asked with data and models.

Niebla sobre la dehesa turolense - 51485034175 · Fernando Gavín · CC BY-SA 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons

I am a quantitative ecologist working on the processes that shape the distribution and abundance of animal populations. My work combines fieldwork, large-scale data synthesis and statistical modelling to address questions in biogeography, movement ecology and conservation. Assistant Professor at the Universidad Complutense de Madrid.
